_notes: Baseline/default store — relies on code defaults in store.js (no plp.selectors/pdp.selectors/branding.footer). July 2 2026: sort label corrected to the live wording "Price: Low to High" (hash #/ps:calculated_price:asc re-verified live — the ps: prefix is correct for this older SearchSpring template); contact/quote/proClub submitUrlPatterns tightened to named Zoho forms (BESTContactUs, BESTRequestQuote1, BestAccessDoorsProClubVIPProgramApplication). PRO CLUB (July 14 2026): the live country dropdown offers -Select- / Canada / United States; the Canada option is an intentional fallback (a Canadian applicant who submits gets an error screen linking to the CA Pro Club form), NOT a region-lock defect, so no allowedCountries restriction is set (the 'offers only allowed countries' test in pro-club-form.cy.js is gated off). personaOverrides gives all BESTUS form tests a US address (the shared personas.json primary address is Canadian). KNOWN DEFICIENCY (July 23 2026, skipped for now — forms.proClub.emailErrorNotVisible): the Pro Club form correctly blocks submission when Email is empty, but the Email_error message never toggles visible (verified live: style stays display:none 1.5s+ after submit) — a Zoho form-config gap isolated to this one field on this one form. pro-club-form.cy.js gates only the visible-error assertion on this flag; the functional no-submission check still runs unconditionally. Revisit once the Zoho form (BestAccessDoorsProClubVIPProgramApplication) is fixed. KNOWN DEFICIENCY (July 23 2026, skipped for now): /content/assets/js/tracking_code.js — loaded only on /request-a-quote/ — is deployed with literal <script>/</script> wrapper tags still inside the file content (a Zoho UTM/lead-tracking snippet meant for inline embedding, mistakenly saved as a standalone external file). Loaded via <script src>, the browser parses the raw text as JS and chokes on the leading '<' (SyntaxError: Unexpected token '<', no stack — same shape as a redacted cross-origin error). Confirmed low-severity: the real Zoho form/submission is unaffected (manual submit works fine) — only this script's own UTM-attribution cookie logic silently never runs on that page. quote-form.cy.js suppresses this one known error via checks.js's KNOWN_BUGGY_SCRIPTS list. Fix means re-uploading tracking_code.js without the wrapper tags, or embedding the snippet inline instead of via external src. RECAPTCHA (Sept 1 2026): /contact-us/ (sitekey 6Lc19yct...) and /pro-club-application/ (sitekey 6Leol0gt...) now render a Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox plus a first-party inline gate — a submit listener that preventDefault()s while grecaptcha.getResponse() === ''. Intentional anti-spam, not a defect, but a v2 checkbox cannot be solved by an automated run (nor by a human mid-run), so on /contact-us/ it blocked every POST and contact-form.cy.js's 3 happy-path tests failed with cy.wait('@submit') 'No request ever occurred' — while every validation test kept passing, because Zoho's own onSubmit attribute handler (zf_ValidateAndSubmit) runs upstream of the gate. checks.js's THIRD_PARTY_HOSTS now stubs /recaptcha/ with a grecaptcha stand-in returning a non-empty token so the gate falls through; forms.contact.hasRecaptcha / forms.proClub.hasRecaptcha record which forms carry it and enable the 'does not submit until the reCAPTCHA is completed' test. Neither the quote form nor the PDP product forms are gated, and no other store in the fleet is (all 23 configured form pages scanned Sept 1 2026) — likely a rollout in progress, so re-scan for the widget when another store's happy path starts failing this way. GATE FRAGILITY (not a current defect, but the reason the enforcement test exists): the snippet installs its submit listener on document.getElementById('zohoForm'), so it does nothing at all unless the form's id matches. On Sept 1 2026 the /pro-club-application/ form was id='form' while contact's was already id='zohoForm' — 'if (!form) return' short-circuited, the widget rendered, and that captcha blocked nothing. Fixed overnight (confirmed by the store owner) and re-checked Sept 2 2026: the id is now 'zohoForm' (5 cache-busted fetches, no HTML variants — not an A/B variant) and the gate enforces — pro-club-form.cy.js's 'does not submit until the reCAPTCHA is completed' test passes. Neither state is visible in the page, so a one-word template edit can disarm the captcha silently; that test is the only thing that would catch it.
